ability.name: Step 7 — DC gate
ability.description: Process and analyze active network signatures, perform active directory root context tests, and dynamically resolve correct next-stage routing.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $dcIp = $null; $baseDn = $null; if (Test-Path "$d\services.json") { $services = Get-Content "$d\services.json" | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($ip in $services.psobject.Properties.Name) { $ports = $services.$ip; $hasLdap = $false; $hasKerb = $false; foreach ($p in $ports) { if ($p.port -eq 389 -or $p.port -eq 636) { $hasLdap = $true }; if ($p.port -eq 88) { $hasKerb = $true } }; if ($hasLdap -or $hasKerb) { $dcIp = $ip; break } } }; if ($dcIp) { Write-Output "DC_IP: $dcIp"; try { $de = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$dcIp/RootDSE"); $baseDn = $de.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value; $dnsHostName = $de.Properties['dnsHostName'].Value; if ($baseDn) { Write-Output "BASE_DN: $baseDn"; Write-Output "DC_HOSTNAME: $dnsHostName"; Write-Output "HAS_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER: true"; Write-Output "RECON_AD_PRESENT: true"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } else { throw 'Base DN resolved to null' } } catch { Write-Output "WARN: RootDSE LDAP lookup failed, using fallback domain resolution"; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; if ($cs.PartOfDomain) { Write-Output "HAS_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER: true"; Write-Output "RECON_AD_PRESENT: true"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } else { Write-Output "HAS_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER: false"; Write-Output "RECON_AD_PRESENT: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } } else { Write-Output "HAS_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER: false"; Write-Output "RECON_AD_PRESENT: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } catch { Write-Output "HAS_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER: false"; Write-Output "RECON_AD_PRESENT: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true"; Write-Output "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\dc_gate.txt

rationale: Secures proper phase routing and retrieves Base Distinguished Name context from active target controller LDAP endpoints.
